content:
#Importation packages
library(ggplot2)
library(recapr)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(shinythemes)
library("shinycssloaders")
library(shiny)
# Server
server <- function(input, output) {
  marquage_plot <- eventReactive(input$submit_max, {
    set.seed(123)  # Fixing seed for reproductability
    
    # Variables: 
    L <- as.numeric(input$max_value)
    nombre_individus <- as.numeric(input$N)
    n_capture_1 <- as.numeric(input$n_capture_1)
    
    distrib_selected <- input$distribution
    
    distrib_marquage <- input$distrib_tagging
    
    sd<- input$sd_value
    
    ecart_type <- input$sd_tag
    
    
    if (distrib_selected=="Homogeneous"){ # random individual positions
      positions_individus <- data.frame(
        id = 1:nombre_individus,  
        x = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L),
        y = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L)
      )
      
    }else{# around a point or a line
      centre <- L*0.4
      generate_position <- function(centre, sd_value, limit) {
        coord <- centre + rnorm(1, sd = sd_value)
        while (coord < 1 || coord > limit) {
          coord <- centre + rnorm(1, sd = sd_value)
        }
        return(coord)
      }
    }
    
    if (distrib_selected=="Concentric"){
      positions_individus <- data.frame(
        id = 1:nombre_individus,
        x = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, sd, L)),
        y = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, sd, L))
      )
    }else if(distrib_selected=="Axial"){
      positions_individus <- data.frame(
        id = 1:nombre_individus,
        x = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L),
        y = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, sd, L))
      )
    }
    
    
    
    # random tagging  ---------------------------
    
    if (distrib_marquage=="Homogeneous"){ # random position
      indices_marques <- sample(nombre_individus, n_capture_1)
      positions_individus<-positions_individus %>% 
        mutate(marquage_1=ifelse(id%in%indices_marques,
                                 "marked",
                                 "unmarked"))
      
    }else if (distrib_marquage=="Concentric") {# parameter of the uneven distribution
      moyenne <-  L*0.4
      
      # Calculate the probabilities of being marked based on the x and y coordinates    
      positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
        mutate(prob_marquage = dnorm(x, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type) * dnorm(y, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type))
      
      # Normalize the probabilities to sum up to 1
      positions_individus$prob_marquage <- positions_individus$prob_marquage / sum(positions_individus$prob_marquage)
      
      # Randomly sample individuals based on the calculated probabilities
      indices_marques <- sample(1:nombre_individus, size = n_capture_1, replace = FALSE, prob = positions_individus$prob_marquage)
      
      # Mark the sampled individuals
      positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
        mutate(marquage_1 = ifelse(id %in% indices_marques, "marked", "unmarked"))
      
      # Filter and count the marked individuals
      individus_marques <- positions_individus %>% 
        filter(marquage_1 == "marked")
      
    }else{ # same with a line
      
      moyenne <- L*0.4
      
      positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
        mutate(prob_marquage = dnorm(y, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type))
      
      positions_individus$prob_marquage <- positions_individus$prob_marquage / sum(positions_individus$prob_marquage)
      
      indices_marques <- sample(1:nombre_individus, size = n_capture_1, replace = FALSE, prob = positions_individus$prob_marquage)
      
      positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
        mutate(marquage_1 = ifelse(id %in% indices_marques, "marked", "unmarked"))
      
      individus_marques <- positions_individus %>% 
        filter(marquage_1 == "marked")
      
    }
    
    
    # Plot with ggplot
    plot_marquage <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = positions_individus, aes(x = x, y = y, color = marquage_1), size = 1100/L) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("marked" = "red2", "unmarked" = "cadetblue2")) +
      coord_equal() +
      xlim(0, L) +
      ylim(0, L) +
      theme_linedraw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    return(list(plot_marquage = plot_marquage,
                positions_individus = positions_individus))
  })
  
  
  marquage_data <- eventReactive(input$submit_vars, {
    set.seed(123)  # fixing random seed
    
    
    x_min <- as.numeric(input$x_min)
    x_max <- as.numeric(input$x_max)
    y_min <- as.numeric(input$y_min)
    y_max <- as.numeric(input$y_max)
    
    positions_individus=marquage_plot()$positions_individus
    
    # recapture plot !
    plot_recapture <- marquage_plot()$plot_marquage +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_min, xmax = x_max, ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max), 
                fill = NA, color = "blue")
    
    # Counting individual in the rectangle
    individus_dans_rectangle <- positions_individus[
      positions_individus$x >= x_min & positions_individus$x <= x_max &
        positions_individus$y >= y_min & positions_individus$y <= y_max,]
    
    #Data fram with the marked and the unmarked individuals
    composition_df <- data.frame(
      Composition = names(table(individus_dans_rectangle$marquage_1)),
      n = as.integer(table(individus_dans_rectangle$marquage_1))
    )
    
    return(list(plot_recapture = plot_recapture,
                composition_df = composition_df,
                individus_dans_rectangle = individus_dans_rectangle))
  })
  
  output$plot_marquage <- renderPlot({
    marquage_plot()$plot_marquage
  })
  
  output$plot_recapture <- renderPlot({
    marquage_data()$plot_recapture
  })
  
  output$individus_dans_rectangle <- renderTable({
    marquage_data()$composition_df
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$recapture, {
    set.seed(123)
    recapture_data <- marquage_data()
    n_capture_2 <- as.numeric(input$n_capture_2)
    
    # checking if n_capture_2 is higher than the total amount of individuals in the rectangle
    if (n_capture_2 > sum(recapture_data$composition_df$n)) {
      # Error message
      showNotification("Number of captured animal can not be higher than the total amount of individuals in the recapture zone.", type = "error")
    } else {
      # Sampling recapture: 
      indices_tirage <- sample(1:nrow(recapture_data$individus_dans_rectangle), n_capture_2, replace = FALSE)
      # SSelect random sampled individuals
      individus_tires <- recapture_data$individus_dans_rectangle[indices_tirage, ]
      marqued_2 <- sum(individus_tires$marquage_1 == "marked")
      unmarqued_2<- sum(individus_tires$marquage_1 == "unmarked")
      
      output$Nchapman <- renderText({
        paste("Chapman estimator: Nchapman =", round(NChapman(
          as.numeric(input$n_capture_1),
          n_capture_2,
          marqued_2),1) # 1 pour le round
        )
      })
      
      output$recapture_marques <- renderText({
        paste("Picked:",
              "marked  =", marqued_2,
              "unmarked  =", unmarqued_2)
      })
    }
  })
  
  
  
  
  
  
  ## Stochastic repetitions ---------------------------------------------------------------
  
  observeEvent(input$go_button| input$submit_max | input$submit_vars, {
    
    Nchap_1=c()
    # get population parameters
    L <- as.numeric(input$max_value)
    nombre_individus <- as.numeric(input$N)
    n_capture_1 <- as.numeric(input$n_capture_1)
    
    
    ecart_type <- input$sd_tag
    
    # population distribution
    distrib_selected <- input$distribution
    distrib_marquage <- input$distrib_tagging
    
    # specify coordonate for recapture
    x_min <- as.numeric(input$x_min)
    x_max <- as.numeric(input$x_max)
    y_min <- as.numeric(input$y_min)
    y_max <- as.numeric(input$y_max)
    
    n_capture_2 <- as.numeric(input$n_capture_2)
    
    
    for (i in seq(1:100)){
      set.seed(i)
      if (distrib_selected=="Homogeneous"){ # 
        positions_individus <- data.frame(
          id = 1:nombre_individus,  
          x = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L),
          y = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L)
        )
      }else{
        centre <- L*0.4
        generate_position <- function(centre, sd_value, limit) {
          coord <- centre + rnorm(1, sd = sd_value)
          while (coord < 1 || coord > limit) {
            coord <- centre + rnorm(1, sd = sd_value)
          }
          return(coord)
        }
      }
      if (distrib_selected=="Concentric"){
        positions_individus <- data.frame(
          id = 1:nombre_individus,
          x = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, L/5, L)),
          y = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, L/5, L))
        )
      }else if(distrib_selected=="Axial"){
        positions_individus <- data.frame(
          id = 1:nombre_individus,
          x = replicate(nombre_individus, generate_position(centre, L/5, L)),
          y = runif(nombre_individus, min = 1, max = L)
        )
      }
      # tagging -----------------------------------------
      if (distrib_marquage=="Homogeneous"){ # Posiiton des individus aléatoire
        indices_marques <- sample(nombre_individus, n_capture_1)
        positions_individus<-positions_individus %>% 
          mutate(marquage_1=ifelse(id%in%indices_marques,
                                   "marked",
                                   "unmarked"))
        
      }else if (distrib_marquage=="Concentric") {
        moyenne <- 200
        
        # Calculer les probabilités d'être marqué en fonction des coordonnées x et y
        positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
          mutate(prob_marquage = dnorm(x, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type) * dnorm(y, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type))
        
        # Normaliser les probabilités pour qu'elles s'ajustent à une somme de 1
        positions_individus$prob_marquage <- positions_individus$prob_marquage / sum(positions_individus$prob_marquage)
        
        # Échantillonner aléatoirement les individus en fonction des probabilités calculées
        indices_marques <- sample(1:nombre_individus, size = n_capture_1, replace = FALSE, prob = positions_individus$prob_marquage)
        
        # Marquer les individus échantillonnés
        positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
          mutate(marquage_1 = ifelse(id %in% indices_marques, "marked", "unmarked"))
        
        # Filtrer et compter les individus marqués
        individus_marques <- positions_individus %>% 
          filter(marquage_1 == "marked")
        
      }else{
        
        # Définir les paramètres de la distribution gaussienne
        moyenne <- 200
        
        # Calculer les probabilités d'être marqué en fonction de la coordonnée y
        positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
          mutate(prob_marquage = dnorm(y, mean = moyenne, sd = ecart_type))
        
        # Normaliser les probabilités pour qu'elles s'ajustent à une somme de 1
        positions_individus$prob_marquage <- positions_individus$prob_marquage / sum(positions_individus$prob_marquage)
        
        # Échantillonner aléatoirement les individus en fonction des probabilités calculées
        indices_marques <- sample(1:nombre_individus, size = n_capture_1, replace = FALSE, prob = positions_individus$prob_marquage)
        
        # Marquer les individus échantillonnés
        positions_individus <- positions_individus %>% 
          mutate(marquage_1 = ifelse(id %in% indices_marques, "marked", "unmarked"))
        
        # Filtrer et compter les individus marqués
        individus_marques <- positions_individus %>% 
          filter(marquage_1 == "marked")
      }
      
      # RECAPTURE ---------------------------------------------------------
      # Resencement des individus dans le rectangle
      individus_dans_rectangle <- positions_individus[
        positions_individus$x >= x_min & positions_individus$x <= x_max &
          positions_individus$y >= y_min & positions_individus$y <= y_max,]
      
      # Tirage aléatoire des indices des individus dans le rectangle
      n_population <- nrow(individus_dans_rectangle)
      
      # Vérifier si la taille de l'échantillon est plus grande que la taille de la population
      if (n_capture_2 > n_population) {
        # Afficher un message d'erreur
        showNotification("Sample size exceeds population size.", type = "error")
      } else {
        # Tirage aléatoire des indices des individus dans le rectangle
        indices_tirage <- sample(1:n_population, n_capture_2, replace = FALSE)
      }
      
      
      # Sélectionner les individus tirés au hasard
      individus_tires <- individus_dans_rectangle[indices_tirage, ]
      
      
      marques=individus_tires %>% filter(marquage_1=="marked") %>% 
        nrow()
      
      ### Estimation de la population ------------------------------------------
      
      Estimateur=NChapman(n_capture_1,n_capture_2,marques)
      Nchap_1 <- c(Nchap_1, Estimateur)
    }
    
    Nchap_1<-data.frame(estimations_chapman=Nchap_1)
    
    output$plot_stochastic <- renderPlot({
      # Tracer le boxplot avec ggplot
      ggplot(Nchap_1, aes(y = estimations_chapman)) +
        geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue1", alpha = 0.4) +
        labs(
          title ="Mean Chapman estimator for 100 random seeds",
          subtitle="Red line = Population Size. Blue line = Sub population in the rectangle ",
          caption  = paste( distrib_selected, "distribution",", xmin=" ,x_min,", xmax=",x_max,", ymin=",y_min,", ymax=",y_max),
          y=""
        ) +
        xlim(-1,1)+
        ylim(0,2*nombre_individus)+
        geom_hline(yintercept = n_population, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue",linewidth=1.6) +  # Ligne pour la taille réelle de la population
        geom_hline(yintercept = nombre_individus, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",linewidth=1.6) +  # Ligne pour la taille réelle de la population
        theme_minimal()+
        theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
              plot.title = element_text(size = 18,face="bold"),  # Ajuster la taille du titre
              plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14) , 
              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)) # Ajuster la taille de la légende
      
      
    })
    
    
    
    
    output$valeurs <- renderTable({ 
      
      nombre_individus <- as.numeric(input$N)
      
      # Filtrer les valeurs inférieures au 10e percentile
      Nchap_y1_95 <- Nchap_1$estimations_chapman[Nchap_1$estimations_chapman >= quantile(Nchap_1$estimations_chapman, 0.05) & Nchap_1$estimations_chapman <= quantile(Nchap_1$estimations_chapman, 0.95)]
      
      # Create dataframe
      result_df <- data.frame(
        . = "Estimator error ",
        RMSE = round(sqrt(mean((nombre_individus-Nchap_y1_95)^2)), 2), # data$actual - data$predicted
        MBE =round(mean(Nchap_y1_95-nombre_individus, 2)) # the Other way, normal
      )
      return(result_df)
      
    })
    
    output$mean_table <- renderTable({ 
      
      
      # Filtrer les valeurs inférieures au 10e percentile
      Nchap_y1_95 <- Nchap_1$estimations_chapman[Nchap_1$estimations_chapman >= quantile(Nchap_1$estimations_chapman, 0.05) & Nchap_1$estimations_chapman <= quantile(Nchap_1$estimations_chapman, 0.95)]
      
      # Create dataframe
      mean_table <- data.frame(
        . = "Mean & Standard deviation ",
        Mean = round(mean(Nchap_y1_95), 2),
        Sd = round(sd(Nchap_y1_95), 2)
      )
      return(mean_table)
      
    })
    
  })
  
  
  
  
}




# UI -------------------
# Définition de l'interface utilisateur
ui <- navbarPage(
  title = "⭐MRR Shiny",
  theme = shinytheme("flatly"),
  tabPanel("Mark 🔖️",
           sidebarLayout(
             sidebarPanel(
               textInput("max_value", "Size of the grid (L) :", value = "500"),
               textInput("N", "N: Total number of individuals ", value = "1000"),
               textInput("n_capture_1", "Number of marked individuals", value = "150"),
               sliderInput("sd_value", "Standard deviation for global distribution:", 
                           min = 50, max = 500, value = 0),
               radioButtons("distribution", "Choose a distribution :",
                            choices = c("Homogeneous", "Concentric", "Axial"),
                            selected = "Homogeneous"),
               sliderInput("sd_tag", "Standard deviation for tagging distribution:", 
                           min = 30, max = 500, value = 75),
               radioButtons("distrib_tagging", "Choose a tagging distribution :",
                            choices = c("Homogeneous", "Concentric", "Axial"),
                            selected = "Homogeneous"),
               actionButton("submit_max", "Submit")
             ),
             mainPanel(
               plotOutput("plot_marquage", width = "500px",height = "500px")
             )
           )
  ),
  tabPanel("Recapture 🎏",
           sidebarLayout(
             sidebarPanel(
               textInput("x_min", "x min (0-L)", value = "150"),
               textInput("x_max", "x max (0-L)", value = "350"),
               textInput("y_min", "y min (0-L)", value = "150"),
               textInput("y_max", "y max  (0-L)", value = "350"),
               actionButton("submit_vars", "Submit"),
               textInput("n_capture_2", "Number of captured indiviual on the second sample", value = "0"),
               actionButton("recapture", "Capture !")
             ),
             mainPanel(
               tabsetPanel(
                 tabPanel("Graph et Table", 
                          fluidRow(
                            column(8, plotOutput("plot_recapture")),
                            column(4, tableOutput("individus_dans_rectangle"),
                                   textOutput("Nchapman"),
                                   textOutput("recapture_marques"))
                            
                          )
                 )
               )
             )
           )
  ),
  tabPanel("Stochastic repetitions 🔁",
           mainPanel(
             actionButton("go_button", "Go"),
             fluidRow(
               column(8, offset = 0,
                      plotOutput("plot_stochastic", width = "500px", height = "700px")),
               column(4, offset = 0,
                      tableOutput("valeurs"),
                      tableOutput("mean_table"))
             )
           )
  )
)

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
